summary: Iteration 50: Cart Merge Flow Bug Fix - Fixed critical bug where login parameters were swapped in CheckoutAuthModal.jsx. All 10 backend tests pass. Frontend cart merge flow now works correctly: guest cart items are merged into server cart after login, and user is redirected to checkout with all items preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CheckoutAuthModal.jsx was calling login(token, user) but App.js login function expects login(user, token) - parameters were swapped
Cart merge flow now works correctly: guest cart stored in localStorage 'pigma_guest_cart', merged via POST /api/cart/add on login
Backend POST /api/cart/add correctly increments quantity for duplicate product_id+size+color combinations
CheckoutPage.fetchAll correctly waits for !isMerging before fetching server cart
CartPage.handleAuthSuccess sets pendingCheckout flag and waits for merge to complete before navigating to /checkout
seed_data_creation: None - tests create unique users with UUID prefixes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart merge flow is now fully functional. The bug was in CheckoutAuthModal.jsx where login() was called with swapped parameters (token, user) instead of (user, token). Fixed all 3 occurrences: OTP verify, email login, and signup. Guest cart uses localStorage key 'pigma_guest_cart'. After login, CartContext.mergeGuestCart() posts each guest item to server via POST /api/cart/add, then clears localStorage.

guest_cart_persistence.details: Guest cart persists on page refresh

cart_merge_on_login.details: Guest cart items merged into server cart via POST /api/cart/add for each item

quantity_summing_for_duplicates.details: Backend POST /api/cart/add increments quantity for duplicate product_id+size+color

checkout_waits_for_merge.details: CheckoutPage waits for !isMerging before fetching server cart

no_redirect_during_merge.details: CheckoutPage does NOT redirect to home while merge is in progress

redirect_to_checkout_after_login.details: After successful login from CartPage auth modal, user is navigated to /checkout with all cart items

cart_count_badge_update.details: Cart count badge updates correctly after merge

bug_fix_details.issue: login() function called with swapped parameters
bug_fix_details.root_cause: App.js defines login(userData, authToken) but CheckoutAuthModal was calling login(res.data.token, res.data.user)
bug_fix_details.fix: Changed all 3 occurrences to login(res.data.user, res.data.token)
